text:
Nora Li: Heads-up 1:30 sync notes 1: Optimize toolkit R3 scope. Customers want practical recs (batching, cache hints, quant presets) + eval alerts. We can't do everything.
Diego Ramos: agree. Suggest slicing by runtime risk: A) runtime changes (batching), B) advisory outputs (quant + cache hints), C) alerting (read-only alerts first).
Ethan Shaw: +1. For batching: propose 2 pilot heuristics only small-batch-for-low-latency and large-batch-for-high-throughput. Keep kernel changes optional.
Priya Kapoor: customers (Retail X, FinReg B) want auditability. That means every recommendation needs an audit row and a one-line rationale. Can we ship that lightweight?
Diego Ramos: yes if we store metadata with the rule: {id, trigger, expected-savings, risk-note}. We'll generate the rationale template from those fields.
Nora Li: Acceptance criteria proposal: - 3 pilot customers onboarded, - show cost delta and latency delta in Console per-route, - no p99 regression > 12% for customers who enable batching, - recommendations served via API + Console advisory card, - eval-alerts initial mode = read-only (no autopruning).
Ethan Shaw: add: feature flags per-customer and per-route; rollout via canary percent.
Priya Kapoor: ops ask: runbook for noisy alerts + clear escalation path. Need to include support SLAs for pilot customers.
Diego Ramos: telemetry plan: attach event tags: opt.toolkit.rule_applied, opt.toolkit.recommendation_viewed, opt.toolkit.alert_fired. We'll need sample sizes for precision estimates.
Nora Li: timeline suggestion: Sprint week 1: design + rule schema, week 2: runtime prototype (heuristic plugin), week 3: telemetry + console stub, week 4: pilot rollout + metrics review.
Ethan Shaw: blocker: infra capacity. If batching increases GPU utilization we may hit limits. Propose soft cap and throttles in runtime.
Priya Kapoor: compliance note: FinReg B requires exportable audit logs in CSV/JSON. Add as must-have for that customer's pilot.
Diego Ramos: engineering owners: runtime = Ethan, infra/telemetry = Diego, console = Nora, customer onboarding = Priya.
ops-bot: Created poll "R3 priority: which piece first?" options: [Batching, Quant advisories, Eval-alerts] Vote here: https://redwood.internal/poll/9981
Nora Li: Decision: prioritize batching (hard enable heuristics) + quant/cache as advisory + eval-alerts read-only. Owners as above.
Ethan Shaw: I'll prototype the two heuristics and provide perf baseline numbers. Expect perf run request by tomorrow.
Priya Kapoor: I'll draft the pilot onboarding checklist and the alert runbook; posting in docs: <https://redwood.internal/docs/optimize/r3-pilot|R3 pilot doc>.
Diego Ramos: will add telemetry events to the backlog and mark dependent infra tasks.
Nora Li: One more acceptance metric: recommendation adoption rate >= 25% in pilot OR we iterate.
Ethan Shaw: :thumbsup:
Priya Kapoor: :white_check_mark:
